notes.nkukubira: Literally “I hit the phone to you”.

guidebook.intro: Make calls, send messages and arrange to meet.

tips.title: Go cim bota
body: To call is **goyo cim**, literally to hit the phone: **Go cim bota** (call me), **Abigoyo cim boti** (I will call you). **Bota** is to me, **boti** to you, **bote** to him or her.

tips.title: Atye ka kuri
body: **Kuro** is to wait: **Atye ka kuri** (I am waiting for you), **Kur manok** (wait a little). **Atye i yo** (I am on the road) is the classic “I’m on the way!”

culture.title: Atye i yo
body: **Atye i yo** may mean the person is still at home. Allow some time, and call again with a smile.
